name: BeyondSWE
intro: BeyondSWE 将软件工程智能体评测扩展到知识范围与修改范围更广的任务，包含 246 个 GitHub 仓库中的 500 个实例：CrossRepo 200 题、DomainFix 72 题、DepMigrate 178 题、Doc2Repo 50 题。四类候选先经过智能体辅助 Docker 环境构建与五次稳定性检查，再接受任务专属专家或人工复核及跨任务审计；提交结果在纯净容器中独立验证。
org: Renmin University of China, AweAI Team
build_method: 四类任务候选挖掘、智能体辅助 Docker、五次稳定性验证、任务专用专家复核
metric: Resolved Rate; Doc2Repo Pass Rate, (Almost) Correct Count
task_type: 软件工程, 跨仓库修复, 代码迁移, 仓库生成
eval_feature: 跨仓库推理、领域知识、依赖迁移、全仓库生成、纯净容器验证
scale: 500 个实例，246 个仓库（200 CrossRepo、72 DomainFix、178 DepMigrate、50 Doc2Repo）
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.03194v2 Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.5, and Appendix C.5-C.6 Tables 10-11. The diagram corrects the legacy flow's repository-count/instance-count confusion and ordering: task-specific candidates first undergo agent-assisted Docker environment construction and five-run stability inspection; the paper's intermediate counts are then about 800 CrossRepo, 200 DomainFix, 1,000 DepMigrate, and 60 Doc2Repo candidates. Task-specific link, domain-expert, SWE-expert, or specification/test review retains 200/72/178/50 tasks. Five senior software engineers next inspect environment construction and data cleaning, followed by final task-quality auditing by five senior PhD researchers in software engineering and LLMs. The final release has 500 unique instances across 246 repositories; fresh-container verification, test restoration, future-history removal, and distinct issue-family versus Doc2Repo metrics remain in the separate evaluation lane.
intro_en: BeyondSWE expands software-engineering agent evaluation along broader knowledge and resolution scopes with 500 instances from 246 GitHub repositories: 200 CrossRepo, 72 DomainFix, 178 DepMigrate, and 50 Doc2Repo. Task-specific candidates first undergo agent-assisted Docker construction and five-run stability inspection, then task-appropriate expert or manual review and a cross-task audit; submissions are independently verified in fresh containers.
build_method_en: Four-Setting Candidate Mining, Agent-Assisted Docker, Five-Run Stability Validation, Task-Specific Expert Review
metric_en: Resolved Rate; Doc2Repo Pass Rate, (Almost) Correct Count
task_type_en: Software Engineering, Cross-repository Fixing, Code Migration, Repository Generation
eval_feature_en: Cross-Repository Reasoning, Domain Knowledge, Dependency Migration, Full-Repository Generation, Fresh-Container Verification
scale_en: 500 instances, 246 repositories (200 CrossRepo, 72 DomainFix, 178 DepMigrate, 50 Doc2Repo)
